topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the conceptual framework of cancer evolution, the role of the microenvironment, and the session's learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Dynamics in Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how tumors evolve through successive clonal selection driven by genetic mutations as well as non-mutational epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tissue hierarchies, stemness characteristics, and the specific cell of origin influence tumor initiation and hierarchical cancer growth.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Promotion and Stromal Codependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how environmental promoters, inflammatory microenvironments, and supportive stromal interactions are required for initiating and sustaining tumor growth.

topics.label: Modern Experimental and Computational Methods for Studying Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the advanced sequencing, spatial transcriptomic, and computational techniques used to map clonal evolution and cellular interactions in tumor tissue.

topics.label: Multi-Factor Synthesis of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the lecture's core themes by integrating mutational burden, cell of origin, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Outlook
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
